design_decisions.decision: Explicit conn.rollback() on all exception paths (single try around the whole transaction) rather than relying on connection close, so the lock is released immediately and the intent is visible; rejected: close-only.
Removed the separate 404 branch for current is None; lock_log's False result covers it, and get_log after the lock cannot be None.
Blocked state detected via pg_stat_activity polling; rejected: fixed sleeps.
